note: The person's verbs that pick what a call does when the model wrote it otherwise (SaidVerbs). Each entry is compared as folded words (lower case, no accents, single spaces: SaidFolders.Spoken). append: a file.write without append over a file of theirs that is there goes as an append when the turn says one of these and none of keepWhole. overwrite: a file.edit of a file of theirs that is there goes as the file.write of its newText over all of it, under the file's hash (the person's yes first), and a file.write without hash nor append over such a file goes under its hash, when the turn says one of these (not «reemplaza X por Y», an edit). operators: a calculator.expression.evaluate of a bare number goes as that operator and the number when the turn says words of exactly one of them.
